integrity: Analytic trace identity, positive-matrix threshold proof, and exact rational reversal witness; selected numerical checks are supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Constant irreducible two-by-two Metzler between-pulse generator; one fixed positive survival fraction for each patch per period.
Nonlinear persistence is proved only for a shared-density crowding term, not for the full stage/weather-dependent vector model.
No independent scientific audit or field validation; earlier matrix-product methods may encompass some of the formula.
title: An exact persistence window from desynchronizing two-patch population control
